name: Il Cammino di Sant'Antonio - Tappa 10G
description_md:
Il Cammino di Sant'Antonio Tappa 10G is a waymarked hiking route located in Italy. This hard trail covers a distance of 31.3 km and requires about 8.0 hours of walking time.

The route features 0 m of ascent and 196 m of descent. It is part of the national waymarked hiking network. The path passes Castello di Asolo within 100 m, Asolo within 400 m, and Veneto within 1700 m.
